summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 861,111 treasury shares (0.03% of capital) on May 11, 2026, at a weighted average price of €23.2258 per share, total consideration ~€20 million, under the buyback program approved by shareholders on May 6, 2026 for the 2026-2028 Long-Term Incentive Plan. The program began May 8; aggregate purchases total 1,736,924 shares (0.06%) for ~€40 million. Eni now holds 88,565,031 treasury shares (2.92% of capital). No board recommendation or advisor named. Mechanical details: the buyback is conducted on Euronext Milan in hourly transactions. What to watch: pace of further repurchases under the first tranche and potential program expansions.
